description: This file defines functions to create and load various configurations of the DETR object detection model, including different ResNet backbones, with options for panoptic segmentation and pretrained weights.

methods.name: _make_detr
methods.description: Creates a DETR model with specified backbone, dilation, number of classes, and mask options.

methods.name: detr_resnet50
methods.description: Creates a DETR model with ResNet-50 backbone, optionally pretrained, with options for postprocessing.

methods.name: detr_resnet50_dc5
methods.description: Creates a DETR model with ResNet-50 backbone with dilation (DC5), optionally pretrained.

methods.name: detr_resnet101
methods.description: Creates a DETR model with ResNet-101 backbone, optionally pretrained.

methods.name: detr_resnet101_dc5
methods.description: Creates a DETR model with ResNet-101 backbone with dilation (DC5), optionally pretrained.

methods.name: detr_resnet50_panoptic
methods.description: Creates a panoptic DETR model with ResNet-50 backbone, with threshold and optional pretrained weights.

methods.name: detr_resnet50_dc5_panoptic
methods.description: Creates a panoptic DETR model with ResNet-50 backbone with dilation, with threshold and optional pretrained weights.

methods.name: detr_resnet101_panoptic
methods.description: Creates a panoptic DETR model with ResNet-101 backbone, with threshold and optional pretrained weights.

methods.name: detr_resnet101_dc5_panoptic
methods.description: Creates a panoptic DETR model with ResNet-101 backbone with dilation, with threshold and optional pretrained weights.
